row.name: From Connection to Impact: SINBON Builds "SINBON City" at electronica 2026, Hall A3, Booth 341
row.description:
From Connection to Impact. Built Together.

For more than three decades, SINBON has been linking the things that matter. Through cables, connectors, and connectivity solutions, we have helped power, connect, and enable the technologies people rely on every day. Today, the conversation with our customers has changed. They are no longer looking only for components. They want partners who understand their challenges and can deliver solutions that create real, lasting impact across their industries and communities.
At electronica 2026, we invite you to step into the SINBON city, an immersive space where you can see how connectivity shapes the world around us, from the data centers behind AI to the devices that care for patients and move people through their cities.

Explore our latest solutions:
  • Customized Connectors — AI infrastructure, HPC & data centers 
  • EV Charging Cables — electric mobility
  • Diagnostic Imaging Cables — healthcare
  • Battery Swapping Cabinets — e-bikes & e-scooters
  • Industrial Robotics — automation & collaborative robots
Every one of these solutions reflects a simple belief: meaningful impact is never created alone. It is built together with our customers, our partners, and the communities we serve.

Visit us at electronica 2026 and let's build what's next, together.
  • Hall A3, Booth 341
  • November 10–13, 2026
  • Messe München, Germany

Come meet the SINBON team, explore what we have built, and discover what connection can make possible. We look forward to building the future with you.
